title: CI: the aggregate Test gate (check-test-shard-results) reds an all-green run on a transient jobs-API 5xx, and re-running failed jobs can never clear it (attempt 2 sees every shard ABSENT)
body:
Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#9771, session `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`). ⛔ Not a claim. A CI-gate defect, measured twice in one hour on all-green heads.

## What happened

`scripts/check-test-shard-results.mjs` (the aggregate `Test` job in `ci.yml`) went red twice for platform reasons, with every `Test (shard N/16)` job `success`.

1. **A transient read failure is a red verdict, which ejects merge groups.**
   - PR #13058, run `39276047959` attempt 1: `GET …/attempts/1/jobs` → HTTP 502, exit 2.
   - Merge group `queue/main/pr-13053-50ba1bb…`, run `39276560990`: the same HTTP 502, exit 2. That removed PR #13053 from the merge queue at 15:33Z, and it had to be re-queued.

   The header's "An unreadable answer is never a pass" is right for 401, 403 and truncation. A 5xx is a transient platform answer, though, and the script has no bounded retry for it, while it already re-reads null-conclusion shards (objectui#10931).
2. **"Re-run failed jobs" can never clear the gate.** After that 502, `rerun_failed_jobs` on run `39276047959` re-ran only the aggregate job. Attempt 2 reads `…/attempts/2/jobs` (`GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT`), which lists only the re-run subset. So all 16 shards read `ABSENT`, exit 3 ("16 test shard(s) produced no job at all … the matrix … and the --shards argument … have come apart"). The script's own docblock at `fetchRunJobs` notes that a subset re-run is not the set the job belongs to, but the shard lookup still reads only the current attempt. The one remedy a seat may use for a platform red therefore reds again with a misleading message, and a full re-push is needed.

## Target

- A bounded retry on 5xx and other transient reads, with the same discipline as the objectui#10931 re-read: bounded, logged, and never a pass on an unread answer.
- On attempt > 1, a shard that is absent from the current attempt is judged by its latest conclusion across earlier attempts of the same run. A shard that ran in no attempt stays ABSENT and red.

## Acceptance

- Pins:
  - one 502 then 200 gives a verdict; persistent 5xx stays exit 2;
  - attempt 2 with shards only in attempt 1, all `success`, passes;
  - attempt 2 with a shard `failure` in attempt 1 and not re-run stays red;
  - a shard present in no attempt stays ABSENT.

## Dedupe

The 30 most recent objectui issues were checked for "shard" / "attempt" in the title: 0 hits. Related: objectui#10931 (the null-conclusion re-read) and objectui#12384 (shard timeouts), neither this.
